description: Header file defining the ModuleComparer class used for comparing symbol modules in the breakpad processor. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and references to resolver types, focusing on verifying correctness of loaded modules.

classes.name: ModuleComparer
classes.description: A class for comparing symbol modules loaded via different resolvers to verify correctness.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares symbol data by loading modules into different resolvers and verifying their data consistency.

methods.name: CompareLine
methods.description: Compares two line entries for equality.

methods.name: ComparePubSymbol
methods.description: Compares two public symbols for equality.

methods.name: CompareWFI
methods.description: Compares two Windows Frame Info objects for equality.

methods.name: CompareCRM
methods.description: Compares contained range maps for equality.
